editorial.blurb: Jacky's delivers fresh, flavorful Mexican comfort food in a laid-back spot where even the free chips and salsa set the bar high.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the counter staff what's in each dish before ordering—their preparations are unique (like their stacked cheese enchiladas or chicken chimichangas loaded with beans and rice), and they're genuinely helpful guiding you through the menu.

topDishes.note: phenomenal with cream sauce, guacamole, and surprisingly good refried beans
fresh, flavorful, piping hot—10x better than other local spots
